items.title: Google launches Lyria 3.5 in the Gemini app, AI Studio and Gemini API
items.headline: Google launches Lyria 3.5 in the Gemini app, AI Studio and Gemini API
items.excerpt: Google has released Lyria 3.5, its best-sounding music generation model yet, now available in the Gemini app, Google AI Studio and the Gemini API. It brings more expressive vocals, richer arrangements and full-length song structure with SynthID watermarking on every track.

items.title: Dreamtonics Completes Its Trilogy With Instrument X
items.headline: Dreamtonics Completes Its Trilogy With Instrument X
items.excerpt: Dreamtonics completes its trilogy with Instrument X, a neural acoustic modelling platform for orchestral instruments that swaps multi-gigabyte sample libraries for a trained model. It joins Synthesizer V and Vocoflex as the Tokyo company's third neural instrument.

items.title: Australia's ARIA bans fully AI-generated songs from its official charts
items.headline: Australia's ARIA bans fully AI-generated songs from its official charts
items.excerpt: Australia's ARIA has joined more than 20 countries in barring fully AI-generated songs from its official charts, though AI can still assist with sound design and arrangement if humans handle songwriting, lead vocals and primary instruments.

items.title: Armin van Buuren & Laidback Luke Partner With AI Music Company Moises
items.headline: Armin van Buuren & Laidback Luke Partner With AI Music Company Moises
items.excerpt: Armin van Buuren and Laidback Luke have joined AI music company Moises as advisors, backing what they call a "responsible" approach to AI tools for DJs and producers such as stem separation and practice aids.

items.title: Logic Pro 12.3, as reviewed by a Cubase version 1 user
items.headline: Logic Pro 12.3, as reviewed by a Cubase version 1 user
items.excerpt: Apple's Logic Pro 12.3 adds Session Players that generate convincing backing performances matched to a project, plus one of the best AI stem separation processes on the market, in an update strong enough to win over a lifelong Cubase user.

items.title: Hotone Pulze Jr. is a mini modelling amp with onboard AI
items.headline: Hotone Pulze Jr. is a mini modelling amp with onboard AI
items.excerpt: The battery-powered Hotone Pulze Jr. packs 52 amp models into a pocket-sized modelling amp, with AI-generated presets that dial in a sound at the touch of a button and AI-powered track separation for backing tracks.

items.title: Luminate to Add Labels to AI Music Later This Year
items.headline: Luminate to Add Labels to AI Music Later This Year
items.excerpt: Data and analytics firm Luminate says it will begin labelling AI-generated tracks in its charts and reporting later this year, adding another major measurement body to the push for AI disclosure standards across the industry.

items.title: FL Studio says GenAI can help people 'get into music-making'
items.headline: FL Studio says GenAI can help people 'get into music-making'
items.excerpt: Generative-AI music tools can be a powerful funnel for bringing complete beginners into human music-making, according to the CEO and CTO of Image-Line, the company behind DAW FL Studio, who frame prompt tools as an on-ramp to the DAW rather than a replacement for it.

items.title: Songscription talks AI and music publishing: 'We need to work alongside the industry'
items.headline: Songscription talks AI and music publishing: 'We need to work alongside the industry'
items.excerpt: Startup Songscription turns recordings into playable sheet music with automatic music transcription and is now pitching that engine to publishers rather than around them, arguing transcription AI is the cooperative end of the music-AI spectrum.

items.title: Elastic Melody now does bass and DFAM-style percussion, too (Mac, iOS)
items.headline: Elastic Melody now does bass and DFAM-style percussion, too (Mac, iOS)
items.excerpt: Elastic Melody was already a go-to generative melody maker for Mac, iPad and iPhone with an Evolver-inspired synth engine. Version 1.2 adds Pitch and Filter Drive modes so it can also generate basslines and percussion, feeding other apps or hardware.

items.title: The sonible smart:chain plugin is an intelligent mixing ecosystem
items.headline: The sonible smart:chain plugin is an intelligent mixing ecosystem
items.excerpt: With sonible smart:chain, the processing chain draws analysis from multiple instances across a DAW session so each channel is shaped in the context of the whole mix, letting seven processors share one AI analysis instead of each guessing in isolation.

items.title: AI models can identify iconic jazz pianists based on their recordings, revealing their 'musical fingerprints'
items.headline: AI models can identify iconic jazz pianists based on their recordings, revealing their 'musical fingerprints'
items.excerpt: Researchers trained models that can name the jazz pianist behind a performance and then show which rhythmic and harmonic habits gave them away, with the authors suggesting it could help attribute unidentified recordings.

items.title: Billboard Affirms Commitment to Transparency Around AI-Generated Music
items.headline: Billboard Affirms Commitment to Transparency Around AI-Generated Music
items.excerpt: Billboard has committed to identifying songs on its charts that were made with AI, setting out how it will flag AI involvement rather than exclude it outright, putting a disclosure standard on the industry's most-watched scoreboard.

items.title: Accentize Chameleon wins Emmy Award
items.headline: Accentize Chameleon wins Emmy Award
items.excerpt: Accentize has received an Engineering, Science & Technology Emmy Award for Chameleon, a plug-in that uses machine learning to automatically match the reverb characteristics of one recording to another, and has become a staple of dialogue post-production for film and TV.
